votes.motion: Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to close the staff meeting and go into the public meeting
Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Pierce, moved to approve the minutes of the Magna Metro Township meeting held on March 10, 2020
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve Resolution 20-04-01 extending the State of Emergency Declaration for COVID-19 Novel Coronavirus until June 30, 2020
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to approve Resolution 20-04-02 extending the State of Emergency Declaration for the March 18, 2020, Magna Earthquake until June 30, 2020

Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to approve Resolution 20-04-03 recognizing and honoring the service of the firefighters and police officers of the UFA and UPD during the COVID-19 and March 18, 2020, Magna Earthquake Emergencies
